selection: Drone-specific type/title plus explicit Iran/IRGC mention; excludes mixed weapons, named proxies, Iran-backed/aligned and suspected records. Incomplete text-screened source subset, not independently verified attribution or a historical census. Interceptions and claimed targeting remain distinct in the original reports.

incidents.coordNote: Deliberately generalized Abu Dhabi coastal-area pin for a reported military-site strike; not an exact base coordinate.
incidents.title: Two Iranian drones hit warehouse at Al Salam naval base
incidents.summary: The UAE Ministry of Defence said two Iranian drones targeted a warehouse at Al Salam naval base in Abu Dhabi, causing a fire in two storage containers and no casualties. Reporting also identified the French naval presence at Zayed Port, Camp de la Paix, as the same affected base area.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Manama-area pin because current reporting varied between Juffair and Seef labels for high-rise damage imagery.
incidents.title: High-rise residential/commercial towers in Manama damaged
incidents.summary: Washington Post and Reuters imagery showed Iranian drone strikes damaging high-rise buildings in Manama, with at least four people reported treated for shrapnel injuries.

incidents.coordNote: Approximate site centroid for Mesaieed Power Plant; not the exact impact point.
incidents.title: Iranian drone targets water tank at Mesaieed Power Plant
incidents.summary: Qatar's Ministry of Defense said one Iranian drone targeted a water tank owned by Mesaieed Power Plant. No human casualties were reported.

incidents.locationName: Ras Laffan Industrial City power plant
incidents.coordNote: Approximate area centroid for Ras Laffan Industrial City; not the exact impact point.
incidents.title: Iranian drone targets power plant in Ras Laffan Industrial City
incidents.summary: Qatar's Ministry of Defense said another Iranian drone targeted a power plant in Ras Laffan Industrial City. No human casualties were reported.

incidents.locationName: Nakhchivan International Airport / nearby village school area (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Pinned to Nakhchivan International Airport because that is the clearest public landmark; the same drone wave also affected an area near a village school.
incidents.title: Azerbaijan says drones hit Nakhchivan airport area
incidents.summary: Azerbaijan accused Iran of sending four drones into Nakhchivan. Reuters reported one hit the terminal building of Nakhchivan International Airport, another landed near a village school, one was intercepted, and four people were injured.

incidents.coordNote: Approximate pin for Bahrain Financial Harbour (Bahrain Bay/Manama).
incidents.title: Drone intercepted near Bahrain Financial Harbour Towers (Israeli embassy complex)
incidents.summary: Al Jazeera (citing Reuters) reported an Iranian drone was intercepted and destroyed in the vicinity of the Bahrain Financial Harbour Towers complex in Manama, which houses the Israeli embassy.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized pin at Bahrain centroid because authorities did not name the specific desalination facility.
incidents.title: Bahrain says desalination plant damaged in Iranian drone attack
incidents.summary: Bahrain's Interior Ministry said an Iranian drone attack caused material damage to a water desalination plant; casualties reported in the same attack wave were tied to a separate Muharraq university-area debris incident.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Doha-area pin because the official statement did not specify an exact intercept point.
incidents.title: Qatar says drones launched from Iran were intercepted
incidents.summary: Qatar's Ministry of Defense said the State of Qatar was subjected to an attack involving drones launched from Iran and that all drones were successfully intercepted.

incidents.locationName: United Arab Emirates — nationwide UAV interception bulletin (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Generalized Abu Dhabi pin for a nationwide air-defense bulletin rather than a single impact point.
incidents.title: UAE says air defences engaged nine UAVs launched from Iran
incidents.summary: The UAE said its air-defence systems on March 25 engaged nine UAVs launched from Iran. No incident-specific casualties were stated in the official bulletin.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Doha-area pin because the defense statement described countrywide interceptions rather than a single impact location.
incidents.title: Qatar said drones launched from Iran targeted the country and were intercepted
incidents.summary: Qatar's Ministry of Defense said the country was targeted by a number of drones launched from Iran and that all were successfully intercepted.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Dubai Port anchorage-area pin because reporting named Anchorage E but did not provide exact vessel strike coordinates.
incidents.title: Iranian drone attack hit Kuwaiti tanker Al Salmi off Dubai
incidents.summary: Dubai authorities and Kuwait Petroleum Corporation said the supertanker Al Salmi was targeted while anchored in Anchorage E off Dubai Port. The strike caused hull damage and a fire on board, which was later extinguished.

incidents.locationName: Thuraya Telecommunications administrative building, Sharjah Central Region (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Generalized Sharjah-area pin because reporting identified a company administrative building in the Central Region without precise coordinates.
incidents.title: Drone reportedly originating from Iran targeted Thuraya Telecommunications building
incidents.summary: Sharjah authorities said a drone reportedly originating from Iran targeted the administrative building of Thuraya Telecommunications in the emirate's Central Region on Monday, March 30.

incidents.locationName: Kuwait International Airport fuel tank area
incidents.coordNote: Pinned to Kuwait International Airport because reporting specified fuel tanks on airport grounds without a more exact sub-site coordinate.
incidents.title: Iranian drone attack set airport fuel tanks ablaze
incidents.summary: Reuters and Kuwaiti official relays said an Iranian drone attack hit fuel tanks at Kuwait International Airport, triggering a major fire and material damage.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Doha-area pin because official reporting described nationwide drone interceptions rather than a single impact site.
incidents.title: Qatar said drones launched from Iran targeted the state and were intercepted
incidents.summary: Qatar's Ministry of Defense said the state was targeted by drones launched from Iran on March 30 and that all were intercepted.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Doha-area pin because official reporting described nationwide drone interceptions without a precise intercept coordinate.
incidents.title: Qatar said multiple drones from Iran targeted the country and were intercepted
incidents.summary: Qatar's Ministry of Defense said multiple drones launched from Iran targeted the country on April 3 and that Qatari forces intercepted and neutralized all of them.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Sitra-area pin because officials reported injuries and property damage from falling shrapnel without a precise address.
incidents.title: Falling shrapnel after drone interception injured four people in Sitra
incidents.summary: Bahraini authorities said four citizens were injured and several homes in Sitra were damaged by shrapnel and debris after interception of Iranian drones.

incidents.coordNote: Approximate Kuwait City ministries-area pin because public reporting described significant damage at a ministries complex without a precise impact coordinate.
incidents.title: Drone strike damaged government ministries office complex
incidents.summary: Kuwaiti state media and Reuters said an Iranian drone hit an office complex for government ministries, causing significant material damage. Kuwaiti fire authorities later said fires at the Ministries Complex were brought under control.

incidents.locationName: Two power generation and water desalination plants in Kuwait (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Generalized Kuwait City-area pin because reporting described attacks on two plants but did not publish exact plant coordinates in the initial bulletin.
incidents.title: Drone attacks damaged two power and water desalination plants
incidents.summary: Reuters and QNA relays said Iranian drone attacks hit two power generation and water desalination plants in Kuwait, causing significant material damage and forcing two power generation units out of service.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Sitra industrial-area pin because company reporting described operational units being hit without precise geocoded impact points.
incidents.title: Iranian drones hit GPIC operational units and triggered fires
incidents.summary: Bahrain's Gulf Petrochemical Industries Company said several operational units were hit by Iranian drones in the early hours of April 5, triggering fires that were later fully extinguished.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Sitra/BAPCO-area pin because reporting described a storage-facility tank fire without exact coordinates.
incidents.title: Iranian drone attack set storage tank on fire at BAPCO Energies facility
incidents.summary: BAPCO Energies said a tank caught fire at one of its storage facilities following an Iranian drone attack. The fire was later extinguished and damage was being assessed.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Qatar pin because official reporting described state-level targeting and interceptions without exact coordinates.
incidents.title: Qatar said an Iranian-launched drone attack targeted the state and all incoming drones were intercepted
incidents.summary: Qatar's Ministry of Defense said the state was targeted on April 6 by an attack involving a number of drones launched from Iran, and that the Qatari Armed Forces intercepted and neutralized all incoming drones.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Fujairah city pin because reporting identified the building but did not publish an exact strike coordinate.
incidents.title: Iranian drone attack targeted Du telecom building in Fujairah
incidents.summary: Authorities in Fujairah said they were responding to an incident involving an Iranian drone attack on the Du telecommunications company building in the emirate.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Kuwait City-area pin because official reporting described a nationwide drone wave without exact intercept coordinates.
incidents.title: Kuwait said air defences were dealing with a morning wave of Iranian drone attacks
incidents.summary: Kuwait said its air defenses were dealing with a wave of Iranian drones launched since 8 a.m. with some drones targeting vital facilities including oil, power and desalination infrastructure.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Sitra-area pin because officials reported injuries and home damage from shrapnel without a precise address.
incidents.title: Shrapnel after interception of an Iranian drone injured two people and damaged homes
incidents.summary: Bahraini authorities said two citizens sustained minor injuries and homes in the Sitra area were damaged by shrapnel after the interception and destruction of an Iranian drone. A fire at one targeted facility was also brought under control.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Erbil-province pin because reporting described en-route interception toward Erbil without a single published intercept coordinate.
incidents.title: Two explosive drones from Iranian territory were shot down en route to Erbil
incidents.summary: Kurdistan counter-terror authorities said fighter jets intercepted and destroyed two explosive-laden drones launched from Iranian territory toward Erbil province at approximately 17:04 local time on April 14.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized pin for Azadi refugee camp area in Sulaymaniyah; source reporting did not provide exact impact coordinates.
incidents.title: Drone strike reportedly hit Azadi refugee camp with material damage
incidents.summary: Shafaq News reported that a drone strike hit Azadi refugee camp housing Iranian Kurdish refugees in Sulaymaniyah within about an hour of an earlier strike in the Surdas area on April 27. Initial reporting described material damage and no casualties.

incidents.coordNote: Approximate pin for Fujairah Oil Industry Zone; exact impact point not published.
incidents.title: Drone strike sparked fire at Fujairah Oil Industry Zone
incidents.summary: UAE and wire-service reporting said a drone attack linked to Iran caused a fire at the Fujairah Oil Industry Zone. Three civilians were reported moderately injured and hospitalized.

incidents.locationName: Surdash camp, Dukan district, Sulaimani province (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Generalized pin for a Kurdish Iranian opposition-linked camp; exact camp coordinates are intentionally not shown.
incidents.title: Two drones struck Komala-linked Surdash camp in Iraqi Kurdistan
incidents.summary: Rudaw reported that two drones struck the Komala-linked Surdash camp in Sulaimani province's Dukan district late May 5, causing material damage but no casualties. FDD's Long War Journal summarized the same attack as part of a wider Iranian campaign against Kurdish Iranian opposition groups in northern Iraq.

incidents.locationName: Girde Chal / Grdachal camp, Erbil province (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Generalized pin for a PDKI/KDPI-linked camp near Erbil; exact camp coordinates are intentionally not shown.
incidents.title: Two drones hit perimeter of PDKI-linked Girde Chal camp near Erbil
incidents.summary: Rudaw reported that the KDPI said Iran's IRGC carried out drone strikes against the PDKI-linked Girde Chal camp near Erbil on May 6, with two drones striking a residential camp housing spouses, children, and elderly relatives of KDPI members.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized pin for a KDPI Peshmerga position in the Balisan mountains; exact position is intentionally not shown.
incidents.title: KDPI says IRGC suicide drones attacked Peshmerga units in Balisan mountains
incidents.summary: Rudaw reported a KDPI statement saying Iran's IRGC attacked KDPI Peshmerga units in the Balisan mountains with several suicide drones at 19:40 local time on May 7. Casualty and damage details were not available in the accessible report.

incidents.locationName: United Arab Emirates airspace and territory (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Country-level generalized pin because public reporting did not identify specific target, impact, or interception coordinates.
incidents.title: UAE air defenses deal with two drones coming from Iran
incidents.summary: Reuters reported that the UAE Defense Ministry said air defenses dealt with two drones coming from Iran on May 10. Iran denied carrying out recent operations against the UAE, so attribution is retained as a UAE official claim reported by Reuters.

incidents.coordNote: Country-level generalized pin because Kuwait's Defence Ministry did not publish specific interception or impact coordinates.
incidents.title: Kuwait says hostile drones detected in its airspace
incidents.summary: Kuwait's army said it detected and dealt with several hostile drones in Kuwaiti airspace at dawn on May 10. Reuters described the incident as the latest cross-border drone activity linked to the Iran conflict; Kuwait did not specify the drones' origin. AP reported no casualties from the Qatar and Kuwait incidents.

incidents.locationName: Saudi airspace after entry from Iraqi airspace (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Generalized northern/eastern Saudi airspace pin because Saudi reporting did not publish exact drone tracks, interception coordinates, or intended targets.
incidents.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts three drones entering from Iraqi airspace
incidents.summary: Reuters reported that Saudi Arabia intercepted three drones on May 17 after they entered Saudi territory from Iraqi airspace. The Saudi defense ministry said it would take necessary operational measures against attempts to violate the kingdom's sovereignty and security. Reuters placed the incident in the context of the Iran conflict and noted that drones have been launched from Iraq toward Gulf countries, including Saudi Arabia and Kuwait. No deaths, injuries, or damage were reported in the accessible coverage.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Strait of Hormuz maritime pin because public reporting did not identify exact drone tracks, ship names, or interception coordinates.
incidents.title: U.S. intercepts Iranian drones threatening Hormuz shipping lanes
incidents.summary: CENTCOM said Iranian forces launched five one-way attack drones that posed a clear threat in and near the Strait of Hormuz; U.S. forces intercepted the drones and prevented another launch from a Bandar Abbas ground-control site. AP and Guardian reporting tied the exchange to threats around the strait and commercial shipping, while Guardian said IRIB separately reported Iranian forces firing at four ships that tried to cross without coordination. No casualties or ship damage were reported in the accessible coverage.

incidents.coordNote: Approximate public-site pin at Kuwait International Airport. Public reporting said Terminal 1 and other airport facilities were damaged; this is not an exact impact coordinate.
incidents.title: Iranian drones damage Kuwait International Airport terminal
incidents.summary: AP reported that Kuwait's Defense Ministry said hostile drones targeted a passenger building at Kuwait International Airport on June 3, killing one Indian national and wounding 63 passengers and workers. AP also reported that Kuwait destroyed missiles and drones from Iran, while U.S. Central Command said Iranian drones deliberately targeted the airport and rejected Iran's claim that the terminal was damaged by a failed U.S.-made interceptor.

incidents.locationName: Strait of Hormuz maritime traffic corridor (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Generalized Strait of Hormuz maritime pin because public reporting did not identify exact drone tracks, vessel names, or interception coordinates.
incidents.title: U.S. forces shoot down Iranian drones threatening Strait of Hormuz maritime traffic
incidents.summary: AP and Guardian reporting said U.S. forces shot down Iranian drones launched toward the Strait of Hormuz, and U.S. Central Command described the drones as posing a threat to regional maritime traffic. No casualties or ship damage were reported in the accessible coverage.

incidents.locationName: Ali Al Salem airbase / Kuwait airspace (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Generalized Kuwait military/airspace pin because public reporting identified Ali Al Salem airbase but did not provide exact drone tracks, impact sites, or interception coordinates.
incidents.title: IRGC says drones targeted Ali Al Salem airbase in Kuwait
incidents.summary: Al Jazeera reported that the IRGC said it launched drone attacks on Ali Al Salem airbase in Kuwait as part of retaliatory strikes on U.S. forces after U.S. attacks near the Strait of Hormuz. Al Jazeera said all projectiles in Bahrain, Kuwait, and Jordan were intercepted without casualties according to authorities, while Iran International cited a Reuters report that nearly all missiles and drones fired at U.S. bases in Bahrain, Kuwait, and Jordan were intercepted.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Bahrain military/airspace pin because public reporting identified the U.S. Fifth Fleet target but did not provide exact drone tracks, impact sites, or interception coordinates.
incidents.title: IRGC says drones targeted U.S. Fifth Fleet in Bahrain
incidents.summary: Al Jazeera reported that the IRGC said it launched drone attacks on the U.S. Fifth Fleet in Bahrain as part of retaliatory strikes on U.S. forces after U.S. attacks near the Strait of Hormuz. Al Jazeera said all projectiles in Bahrain, Kuwait, and Jordan were intercepted without casualties according to authorities, while Iran International cited a Reuters report that nearly all missiles and drones fired at U.S. bases in Bahrain, Kuwait, and Jordan were intercepted.

incidents.locationName: Strait of Hormuz commercial shipping corridor (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Generalized Strait of Hormuz maritime pin because public reporting did not identify exact drone tracks, intended vessels, or interception coordinates.
incidents.title: U.S. forces shoot down Iranian one-way attack drones aimed at Strait of Hormuz shipping
incidents.summary: Reuters reported that U.S. forces intercepted and shot down multiple Iranian one-way attack drones aimed at the Strait of Hormuz. The drones were considered a threat to commercial shipping in the strategic waterway. Guardian live coverage also reported that U.S. Central Command confirmed shooting down multiple Iranian attack drones targeting commercial vessels in the Strait. No casualties or ship damage were reported in the accessible coverage.

incidents.coordNote: Country-level generalized pin because Reuters did not identify the specific U.S. facility targeted.
incidents.title: Iranian drone wave reportedly targeted U.S. forces in Kuwait
incidents.summary: Reuters reported that a further wave of Iranian drones targeting U.S. forces in Kuwait failed to hit its intended targets.

incidents.locationName: M/V Ever Lovely, Strait of Hormuz sea area (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Generalized Strait of Hormuz pin; not the vessel's exact position.
incidents.title: M/V Ever Lovely bridge damaged by Iranian drone strike
incidents.summary: The Guardian and Reuters reported that a cargo ship, M/V Ever Lovely, was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday, damaging the bridge. UKMTO said there were no casualties or environmental impact; U.S. officials attributed the attack to Iran.

incidents.locationName: M/T Kiku, Strait of Hormuz sea area (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Generalized Strait of Hormuz pin; not the vessel's exact position.
incidents.title: M/T Kiku tanker attacked by Iranian drone in Strait of Hormuz
incidents.summary: AP and Reuters reported that the Panama-flagged tanker M/T Kiku was attacked by an Iranian drone in the Strait of Hormuz. The crew was reported safe and no environmental damage was immediately reported.

incidents.locationName: Bahrain national territory / U.S. military sites (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Generalized Bahrain pin; public reports did not provide precise drone impact or intercept coordinates.
incidents.title: Bahrain reports Iranian drone attack; IRGC says U.S. sites targeted
incidents.summary: Bahrain said a number of Iranian drones were launched at the country on June 27, with no immediate reports of damage. Reuters later reported that Iran's Revolutionary Guards launched missile and drone operations targeting U.S. military sites in Bahrain and Kuwait; a U.S. official reported no U.S. casualties or major damage.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Azraq-area military pin; the record reflects an Iranian claim with no independent impact confirmation at publication time.
incidents.title: Iran claims drone attack on U.S.-used Al-Azraq Air Base
incidents.summary: Later reporting said a drone attack on Muwaffaq Salti Air Base near Al-Azraq wounded about 20 U.S. service members. The base was attacked again the following day in a separate fatal strike. Because the published injury toll is approximate, the structured injury count remains unknown.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Erbil military-area pin; not the exact unexploded-ordnance location.
incidents.title: U.S. soldier killed detonating downed Iranian drone at Erbil Air Base
incidents.summary: A U.S. soldier was killed and another sustained a minor injury during a controlled detonation of a downed Iranian one-way attack drone at Erbil Air Base. The Department of War dated the death July 19; an earlier CENTCOM statement described the incident as occurring July 18. The official casualty-release date is used here.

incidents.locationName: Bahrain Flight Information Region and national airspace (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Country-level generalized pin because the civil-navigation equipment and interception points were not disclosed.
incidents.title: Iranian drones target Bahrain civil air-navigation equipment
incidents.summary: Bahrain's civil aviation authority said hostile drones targeted air-navigation equipment serving the Bahrain Flight Information Region, though flight operations continued normally. The Bahrain Defence Force separately said it intercepted and destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks that day. These reports are combined as one national wave.

incidents.locationName: Bahraini airspace / Sheikh Isa Air Base claim (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Country-level generalized military pin; exact interception and claimed impact coordinates were not published.
incidents.title: Bahrain intercepts Iranian wave; Iran claims Sheikh Isa drone strikes
incidents.summary: The Bahrain Defence Force said it intercepted and destroyed Iranian aerial attacks on July 22. Iran's army separately claimed Arash drones struck equipment warehouses and aircraft-maintenance hangars at Sheikh Isa Air Base. Reuters could not verify the claimed base impacts, so only the occurrence of the national attack wave is treated as confirmed.

incidents.coordNote: Country-level pin combining national drone interceptions with two same-day attacks on Al-Abdaly border crossing; exact interception tracks and impact coordinates are not shown.
incidents.title: Kuwait intercepts Iranian drones; Al-Abdaly crossing struck twice
incidents.summary: Kuwait's air defenses intercepted hostile drones during renewed Iranian attacks on July 23. Hostile drones also struck the Al-Abdaly border crossing with Iraq twice that day, causing material damage and a fire but no casualties. Kuwait's foreign ministry blamed Iran and its proxies for the attacks.

incidents.coordNote: Country-level generalized military pin because Bahrain did not disclose interception coordinates and Iran's claimed impact locations were not independently verified.
incidents.title: Bahrain intercepts renewed Iranian aerial attack wave
incidents.summary: The Bahrain Defence Force said it intercepted and destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks on July 24. Iran separately claimed Arash drone strikes on Sheikh Isa Air Base facilities and damage to a U.S. Fifth Fleet surveillance tower; those claimed target effects were not independently confirmed.

incidents.coordNote: Country-level generalized military pin because Kuwait did not disclose interception coordinates and Iran's claimed impact locations were not independently verified.
incidents.title: Kuwait intercepts Iranian drone wave as Tehran claims U.S. camps
incidents.summary: Kuwait's armed forces said they were intercepting hostile drones on Friday amid Iranian aggression. Iran separately claimed drone attacks on Camp Udairi, Camp Doha, Camp Arifjan, and Ali Al Salem Air Base, but Kuwait and the United States did not confirm the claimed impacts or casualties.

incidents.coordNote: Country-level pin because Jordan did not publish the drone tracks, interception points, or debris locations.
incidents.title: Jordan downs two drones from Iranian territory
incidents.summary: Jordan's armed forces said Royal Jordanian Air Force aircraft intercepted and downed two drones that entered Jordanian airspace from Iranian territory. Officials reported no casualties or material damage, and engineering teams handled debris at several undisclosed locations.

incidents.locationName: Vital facilities, including a northern government structure (generalized)
incidents.coordNote: Country-level pin because Kuwait named no facilities and disclosed only that one government structure was in the north.
incidents.title: Iranian drones hit vital facilities in Kuwait
incidents.summary: Kuwait's army said it destroyed hostile drones and described an Iranian attack on several vital facilities. A government facility in northern Kuwait and civilian property on Bubiyan Island were hit; falling shrapnel caused material damage but no casualties.

incidents.coordNote: Broad strait pin; neither ADNOC nor the UK Maritime Trade Operations centre released the vessels' names, positions, or the points where the drones struck.
incidents.title: Drones strike two ADNOC tankers in Strait of Hormuz
incidents.summary: Abu Dhabi's state-owned ADNOC said two of its tankers were attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday evening, that the attack caused no injuries and that the situation had been brought under control. The British military's UK Maritime Trade Operations centre said two vessels suffered minor damage when attacked by drones in the strait, without identifying them as the ADNOC ships. The UAE Foreign Ministry blamed Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps and called the attacks acts of piracy.

incidents.coordNote: Generalized Erbil-area pin; it does not identify the prime minister's office or the official's residence.
incidents.title: Drones launched from the Iranian border target Kurdish PM's office
incidents.summary: The Kurdistan Region's counterterrorism service said two drones launched from the border with Iran targeted the office of Masrour Barzani, prime minister of Iraq's semi-autonomous Kurdish region, and the home of a top regional intelligence official. There were no casualties and no immediate claim of responsibility. Barzani called the attack a dangerous escalation and a direct threat to the region's security, while Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said nothing justified it and warned Kurdish officials against false-flag attempts to sow discord.
